test_cases.name: testLendRecordsLoan
test_cases.message: After lend("978-0-01", "Ana"), loansOf("Ana") should contain the title "The Quiet Harbour".

test_cases.name: testLendUnknownBookThrows
test_cases.message: Lending a book the library does not own should throw an IllegalStateException.

test_cases.name: testLendAlreadyLentBookThrows
test_cases.message: Lending a book that is already on loan should throw an IllegalStateException.

test_cases.name: testGiveBackEndsLoan
test_cases.message: After the only book of "Ana" was given back, loansOf("Ana") should return an empty list.

test_cases.name: testGiveBackBookNotLentThrows
test_cases.message: Giving back a book that is not on loan should throw an IllegalStateException.

test_cases.name: testLoansOfListsTitlesInLendingOrder
test_cases.message: loansOf("Ana") should list the titles of exactly the books lent to "Ana", in the order they were lent.

test_cases.name: testLoansOfMemberWithoutLoans
test_cases.message: A member without loans should get an empty list, not null.
